images.subject: A metal mining complex, one towering multi-level industrial building built directly around the wide dark mouth of a mine tunnel cut into the cliff face, with one massive conveyor carrying raw ore out of the tunnel. On the right side of the frame, next to the tunnel, stands a second large and clearly separate block: a dedicated foundry building with glowing orange furnace mouths, two tall smoking chimneys and rows of glowing molten metal ingots cooling outside.
images.detail: Thick veins of raw silver and copper metal run through the exposed rock around the tunnel mouth.
images.state: Far-future high-tech mining machinery in active use, with composite panels and polished metal coated in fine grey rock dust, and illuminated light strips.
images.site: It is built into the foot of a towering dark neutral grey rock cliff heavily covered with thick white snow and ice, with the ground all around blanketed in deep white snow and snowdrifts, on a frozen lifeless alien planet of bare rock, ice and wind-blown snow.

images.subject: A metal mining complex, one towering multi-level industrial building built directly around the wide dark mouth of a mine tunnel cut into the cliff face, with one massive conveyor carrying raw ore out of the tunnel. On the right side of the frame, next to the tunnel, stands a second large and clearly separate block: a dedicated foundry building with glowing orange furnace mouths, two tall smoking chimneys and rows of glowing molten metal ingots cooling outside. In the left half of the frame, a third massive and clearly separate block, larger than the main building: a huge multi-level mining building carved deep into the mountain itself, its facade embedded in the cliff face and rising high up the rock, with a second wide tunnel mouth at its base and its own massive conveyor.
images.detail: Thick veins of raw silver and copper metal run through the exposed rock around the tunnel mouths.
